record.context_brief: spectral radius bound from unsigned spectral radius
record.original_question: If ρ is the spectral radius of a connected graph G, is there a signature σ such that the signed spectral radius satisfies ρ(G, σ) < 2 sqrt(ρ - 1)?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.26. If ρ is the spectral radius of a connected graph G, then is there a signature σ such that ρ(G, σ) < 2 √ ρ − 1 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a connected simple graph with adjacency spectral radius $\rho=\rho(G)$, defined as the largest eigenvalue of the (0,1)-adjacency matrix of $G$. A signature of $G$ is a map $\sigma:E\to\{+1,-1\}$, and the signed adjacency matrix $A^\sigma$ has entries $A^\sigma_{uv}=\sigma(uv)$ if $uv\in E$ and $0$ otherwise. The signed spectral radius $\rho(G,\sigma)$ is defined as $\max\{|\lambda|:\lambda\text{ is an eigenvalue of }A^\sigma\}$.

Determine whether, for every connected graph $G$, there exists a signature $\sigma:E\to\{+1,-1\}$ such that
$$\rho(G,\sigma) < 2\sqrt{\rho(G)-1}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a non-regular generalization of the Bilu–Linial conjecture (which concerns d-regular graphs and the bound 2√(d−1)). Bilu–Linial remains open in general; it is known for bipartite graphs (Marcus–Spielman–Srivastava) and in weaker O(d·log³ d) form. Surveys of open problems in spectral theory of signed graphs continue to list this generalized question as open, with no published resolution found.

status_evidence.title: Signing a graph to have small magnitude eigenvalues — Open Problem Garden
status_evidence.snippet: The Bilu-Linial conjecture states that every d-regular (d>1) graph has a signing with spectral radius at most 2√(d-1).
status_evidence.claim: The regular case (Bilu–Linial) is itself listed as an open problem; the non-regular generalization with ρ in place of d is therefore at least as hard.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in the spectral theory of signed graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems in the spectral theory of signed graphs (survey listing problems including signature and spectral radius questions).
status_evidence.claim: This survey lists the question among open problems on signed spectral radius.

status_evidence.title: Interlacing families I: Bipartite Ramanujan graphs of all degrees
status_evidence.snippet: Marcus, Spielman and Srivastava prove a variant of the Bilu–Linial conjecture for bipartite graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Only the bipartite/regular variant has been confirmed; the general signed-spectral-radius bound for arbitrary connected graphs is not established.
